title: AgentOS Issue Registrar — Permanent
description: Portable single-writer issue registration, immutable numbering, typed lifecycle, and deterministic projection contract.

state_rules.numbering: Reserve a unique number before validating non-duplicate input; issue IDs are never reused, deleted, or renumbered.
state_rules.incomplete: Incomplete standardized input remains visible as INTAKE_FAILED/NOT_AUTHORIZED with failure code INCOMPLETE_STANDARDIZED_ISSUE and every missing/invalid field.
state_rules.duplicates: A duplicate preserves the reporter snapshot and evidence and links to the existing issue without consuming a number.
state_rules.owner_decisions: Only Project Owner authority may set DEFERRED, ACCEPTED_RISK, or WONT_FIX.
state_rules.writer: Only AGENTOS.ISSUE_REGISTRAR may atomically write operations-root/issues.md and operations-root/cleared-issues.md; partial writes, symlink targets, and collisions fail closed.
state_rules.delivery: A full record enters cleared-issues.md only after an identical-byte independent PASS and equal local, fetched-origin, and GitHub commit/tree identities.
state_rules.privacy: Security-sensitive evidence is represented by controlled opaque references and never stores raw secret payloads.
state_rules.repair_scope: Admission requires exactly one compliant READY root issue plus a bounded causal seam-closure set. Every companion is a registered SEAM_FINDING or SCOPE_AMENDMENT with CHILD_OF, DEPENDS_ON, SAME_ROOT_CAUSE, or explicit Owner atomic-seam relation.
state_rules.scope_safety: Unrelated, speculative, broad-audit, product-intent, self-authorized, or custody-conflicting findings remain visible as provisional/READY follow-ons and are excluded from the active candidate.
state_rules.handoff: Immutable handoffs enumerate the root issue, every companion ID, in-seam rationale, bounded paths, and verification mapping.
state_rules.blueprint_reference: An issue may retain only a reference to an accepted immutable Blueprint release: release_id, relative path, and SHA-256. Blueprint content, factual/advisory payloads, producer notices, acknowledgements, and BLUEPRINT_CONSUMED traffic are never embedded in issue state.

blueprint_reference.path_rule: relative package path only; no traversal, absolute path, or host identity
